placeholder.titleQuestion: e.g. Graceful shutdown in tokio — how?

help.body: posts are markdown: **bold**, *italic*, `code`, lists, tables and task lists work. Math uses $$block$$ or $inline$ (KaTeX). Diagrams use a ```mermaid fence, charts a ```chart fence with JSON ({"v":1,"type":"line|area|bar|stacked-bar|scatter","series":[{"name":"…","data":[…]}]}). Add fig=id and caption="…" after the fence language to make it a figure. Raw HTML is not rendered; at most 8 diagrams and charts per post.
